termsSections.title: 1. Purpose
termsSections.body: These Terms govern the use of TradeDocu (the "Service"), a web tool for creating and managing trade documents such as proforma invoices.

termsSections.title: 2. Service
termsSections.body: The Service provides tools to create, save, and export trade documents. Features may be changed or discontinued with notice when possible.

termsSections.title: 3. Accounts
termsSections.body: You may register via email or social login (Google, Kakao). You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and providing accurate information.

termsSections.title: 4. User obligations
termsSections.body: You must comply with applicable laws and these Terms. You must not misuse the Service or infringe others' rights.

termsSections.title: 5. Disclaimer
termsSections.body: The Service does not guarantee the legal or commercial suitability of documents you create. We are not liable for damages caused by force majeure or system failures beyond reasonable control.

termsSections.title: 6. Contact
termsSections.body: For questions about these Terms, contact the Service operator.

privacySections.title: 1. Information we collect
privacySections.body:
We may collect:
· Required: email (email signup), display name
· Optional: company name, seller and bank profile data
· Social login: profile data from Google/Kakao (name, email, etc.)

privacySections.title: 2. Purpose
privacySections.body: Authentication, providing the Service, storing documents, support, security, and service improvement.

privacySections.title: 3. Retention
privacySections.body: We retain data while your account is active. Data is deleted when no longer needed or upon account deletion, subject to legal retention requirements.

privacySections.title: 4. Third parties
privacySections.body:
We do not sell your data. Processors include:
· Supabase (auth and database)
· Google / Kakao (social login)
· Vercel (hosting)

privacySections.title: 5. Your rights
privacySections.body: You may access, correct, or delete your data via profile settings or by contacting us.

privacySections.title: 6. Contact
privacySections.body: For privacy inquiries, contact the Service operator.
